package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type assistanceReplayRepository struct {
	ports.Repository
	instance    domain.TaskInstance
	stored      ports.AssistanceReceipt
	digest      string
	writes      int
	reads       int
	lookupError error
}

func (r *assistanceReplayRepository) GetInstance(_ context.Context, student, instance string) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	if student != r.instance.StudentID || instance != r.instance.ID {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return r.instance, nil
}
func (r *assistanceReplayRepository) GetAssistance(_ context.Context, student, instance, usage string) (ports.AssistanceReceipt, string, error) {
	r.reads++
	if r.lookupError != nil {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, "", r.lookupError
	}
	if student != r.instance.StudentID || instance != r.instance.ID || usage != r.stored.UsageID {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, "", domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return r.stored, r.digest, nil
}
func (r *assistanceReplayRepository) RecordAssistance(_ context.Context, instance domain.TaskInstance, receipt ports.AssistanceReceipt, digest string) (domain.TaskInstance, ports.AssistanceReceipt, bool, error) {
	r.writes++
	// Mirrors the original PostgreSQL comparison, so time drift is a real RED.
	if r.stored.UsageID != "" {
		if r.digest != digest || r.stored != receipt {
			return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, domain.ErrIdempotency
		}
		return r.instance, r.stored, false, nil
	}
	instance.Version++
	r.instance, r.stored, r.digest = instance, receipt, digest
	return instance, receipt, true, nil
}
func assistanceReplayFixture() (*assistanceReplayRepository, ports.AssistanceReceipt) {
	r := &assistanceReplayRepository{instance: domain.TaskInstance{
		ID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		LearningActionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Status: domain.TaskInstanceInProgress,
		Steps: []domain.Step{{ID: "step-1"}}, Version: 1,
	}}
	receipt := ports.AssistanceReceipt{Schema: "practice-task-assistance-usage.v1", UsageID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		StudentID: r.instance.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: r.instance.ID, StepID: "step-1", Kind: "HINT", HintLevel: 2}
	return r, receipt
}
func TestT13AssistanceReplayPrecedesCurrentGuards(t *testing.T) {
	for _, status := range []domain.TaskInstanceStatus{domain.TaskInstanceInProgress, domain.TaskInstanceInReview, domain.TaskInstanceCompleted, domain.TaskInstanceCancelled} {
		t.Run(string(status), func(t *testing.T) {
			repo, input := assistanceReplayFixture()
			firstTime := time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 1, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
			runtime := &Runtime{Repository: repo, Now: func() time.Time { return firstTime }}
			first, err := runtime.RecordAssistance(context.Background(), input.TaskInstanceID, input)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			repo.instance.Status = status
			repo.instance.HintsUsed = 1000
			repo.instance.LearningActionID = ""
			repo.instance.Steps = nil
			before := repo.instance
			restarted := &Runtime{Repository: repo, Now: func() time.Time { return firstTime.Add(time.Hour) }}
			replay, err := restarted.RecordAssistance(context.Background(), input.TaskInstanceID, input)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("exact committed replay after %s: %v", status, err)
			}
			if replay != first || repo.writes != 1 || repo.instance.Version != before.Version || repo.instance.HintsUsed != before.HintsUsed || repo.instance.Status != before.Status {
				t.Fatal("replay changed receipt or aggregate")
			}
			changed := input
			changed.HintLevel++
			if _, err := restarted.RecordAssistance(context.Background(), input.TaskInstanceID, changed); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrIdempotency) {
				t.Fatalf("changed payload: %v", err)
			}
			foreign := input
			foreign.StudentID = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
			reads := repo.reads
			if _, err := restarted.RecordAssistance(context.Background(), input.TaskInstanceID, foreign); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
				t.Fatalf("foreign owner: %v", err)
			}
			if repo.reads != reads || repo.writes != 1 {
				t.Fatal("foreign owner reached receipt lookup or mutated")
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestT13AssistanceNewFactsKeepCurrentGuards(t *testing.T) {
	for _, guard := range []string{"lifecycle", "action", "step", "hint_cap"} {
		t.Run(guard, func(t *testing.T) {
			repo, input := assistanceReplayFixture()
			switch guard {
			case "lifecycle":
				repo.instance.Status = domain.TaskInstanceInReview
			case "action":
				repo.instance.LearningActionID = ""
			case "step":
				repo.instance.Steps = nil
			case "hint_cap":
				repo.instance.HintsUsed = 1000
			}
			_, err := (&Runtime{Repository: repo}).RecordAssistance(context.Background(), input.TaskInstanceID, input)
			if err == nil || repo.writes != 0 {
				t.Fatal("new assistance bypassed guard")
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestT13AssistanceReplayUsesOriginalServerFacts(t *testing.T) {
	repo, input := assistanceReplayFixture()
	firstTime := time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 1, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	first, err := (&Runtime{Repository: repo, Now: func() time.Time { return firstTime }}).RecordAssistance(context.Background(), input.TaskInstanceID, input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	input.PolicyVersion = "caller-policy"
	input.OccurredAt = firstTime.Add(24 * time.Hour)
	replay, err := (&Runtime{Repository: repo, Now: func() time.Time { return firstTime.Add(time.Hour) }}).RecordAssistance(context.Background(), input.TaskInstanceID, input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("server time drift blocked replay: %v", err)
	}
	if replay != first || repo.writes != 1 {
		t.Fatal("caller/server time or policy overwrote original receipt")
	}
}

func TestT13AssistanceReceiptLookupFailsClosed(t *testing.T) {
	repo, input := assistanceReplayFixture()
	repo.lookupError = domain.ErrDependency
	if _, err := (&Runtime{Repository: repo}).RecordAssistance(context.Background(), input.TaskInstanceID, input); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDependency) {
		t.Fatalf("lookup failure: %v", err)
	}
	if repo.writes != 0 {
		t.Fatal("lookup failure fell through to a fresh write")
	}
}
func TestT13AssistanceReplayConfirmsEveryStableField(t *testing.T) {
	for _, field := range []string{"schema", "usage", "student", "instance", "step", "kind", "hint", "policy", "time"} {
		t.Run(field, func(t *testing.T) {
			repo, input := assistanceReplayFixture()
			if _, err := (&Runtime{Repository: repo}).RecordAssistance(context.Background(), input.TaskInstanceID, input); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			switch field {
			case "schema":
				repo.stored.Schema = "different"
			case "usage":
				repo.stored.UsageID = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
			case "student":
				repo.stored.StudentID = "different"
			case "instance":
				repo.stored.TaskInstanceID = "different"
			case "step":
				repo.stored.StepID = "different"
			case "kind":
				repo.stored.Kind = "TEACHER_QUESTION"
			case "hint":
				repo.stored.HintLevel = 3
			case "policy":
				repo.stored.PolicyVersion = ""
			case "time":
				repo.stored.OccurredAt = time.Time{}
			}
			// The lookup represents a corrupt persisted/provider receipt, including
			// a wrong returned usage ID; do not let the fake hide it as absent.
			repoOverride := &assistanceCorruptReceiptRepository{assistanceReplayRepository: repo}
			if _, err := (&Runtime{Repository: repoOverride}).RecordAssistance(context.Background(), input.TaskInstanceID, input); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("corrupt stored receipt accepted")
			}
			if repo.writes != 1 {
				t.Fatal("corrupt replay mutated aggregate")
			}
		})
	}
}

type assistanceCorruptReceiptRepository struct{ *assistanceReplayRepository }

func (r *assistanceCorruptReceiptRepository) GetAssistance(context.Context, string, string, string) (ports.AssistanceReceipt, string, error) {
	return r.stored, r.digest, nil
}
